item.stem:
The diagram shows trapezium $PQRS$ with $PQ\parallel SR$. Angle $QPS=65^{\circ}$. Farhan wants angle $PSR$ on the same non-parallel side as angle $QPS$.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Angle $PSR=65^{\circ}$ because angle $PSR$ must equal angle $QPS$ in a trapezium.
options.B: Angle $PSR$ cannot be found from the parallel sides alone.
options.C: Angle $PSR=115^{\circ}$ because the angles on the same non-parallel side between the parallel sides add to $180^{\circ}$.
options.D: Angle $PSR=65^{\circ}$ because $PQ$ equals $SR$ on the diagram.
